name: – Nils Ušakovs – § 7 – Am 55
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 7. Emphasises the critical role of cohesion policy, as an investment instrument, in fostering sustainability and upward social and territorial convergence; reiterates that the cohesion policy’s added value depends on its effective, inclusive and timely implementation based on a reinforced partnership principle; observes that the growing challenges posed by the current economic, social and geopolitical context are constraining cohesion policy funds; calls for reinforced funding to address these issues, ensuring the sustainability and improvement of people’s quality of life across all regions, boosting the EU’s and the regions’ development and innovation, and addressing demographic challenges, thereby contributing to the well-being;
